founder.title: Built by someone who's
founder.quoteStart: I've worked remotely for companies in Singapore, Australia, and the US for seven years.
founder.quoteStrong: Top Plus on Upwork. Over 10,000 hours billed.
founder.quoteEnd: Every year, dozens of people ask me the same question: how did you find it?
founder.p1: I couldn't answer that question for each person individually. So I built the answer instead.
founder.p2: Every job here gets reviewed by me before going live. Salary ranges are required. I check the company is real, the team is hiring, and the comp is fair for VN talent. If it's not, it doesn't go up.
founder.role: Founder · Đà Nẵng, Vietnam · Building since Mar 2025

1.quote: I tried Upwork for two years but the competition was brutal. Through this platform I applied to a Singapore startup that fit my timezone and got an offer at $2,800/month within three weeks.

2.quote: The salary benchmark was a game-changer. I'd been undercharging by 40%. Renegotiated my current contract using the data here and got bumped up before even applying anywhere.
